large_scale_data_handling.optimization: Downcast numeric types early (float64 -> float32, int64 -> int32) to clean VRAM space for GPU training.

self_loop_masking.finding: 100% of CashIn and CashOut transactions are logged with SRC_ACCOUNT == DST_ACCOUNT because Agent profiles are omitted from the KYC matrix.
self_loop_masking.action_required: Do not treat self-loops as a separate leakage feature. They are mathematically identical to basic CashIn/CashOut counts. The pipeline must focus on the monetary volume relationship between them instead of raw counts.

synthetic_vulnerabilities_to_audit: Timestamp Truncation: Check if churning users have transaction logs that abruptly stop mid-March, while active users stretch until March 31st.
ID Sequence Ordering: Check if the alphanumeric index string values of TrxID or ACCOUNT_ID map chronologically or cluster target classes.

imbalance_mitigation.implementation: Set scale_pos_weight = 6.88 in LightGBM/XGBoost configuration based on the 1:7 negative-to-positive label ratio.
